Admin.title: Clicksp admin

levelIntro.superAdmin: You have full access to the business and the technical settings.
levelIntro.businessAdmin: You manage products, orders, finance and your store staff.
levelIntro.storeStaff: You work on products, stock, orders and content you have been given access to.

Admin.yourAreasHelp: What your role can open. Areas marked “Coming soon” arrive in the next phase (products, motorcycles, stock and orders).

upcoming.products: Products with Persian and English details, SKU, OEM and part numbers, images, variants and prices.
upcoming.categories: The category tree for parts, accessories, safety gear and maintenance.
upcoming.motorcycles: Motorcycle manufacturers, models, years and variants, and verified part fitment.
upcoming.inventory: Warehouses, stock balances, receiving, issuing, transfers and stock counts.
upcoming.orders: Orders, their status history, shipping and returns.
upcoming.approvals: Price changes and stock adjustments proposed by staff, waiting for your approval.
upcoming.accounting: Double-entry accounts, journals, income, expenses and financial periods.
upcoming.shipping: Shipping methods, zones, rates and shipments.
upcoming.payments: Iranian payment gateways (added when you choose a provider and have a merchant account).
upcoming.content: Articles, menus, banners and site content.
upcoming.pageBuilder: The visual page builder for the home page and other pages, with drafts, preview and rollback.
upcoming.technical: Integrations, backups, deployments and technical monitoring.

AdminAuth.loginSubtitle: For store managers and staff only.
AdminAuth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
AdminAuth.mfaCodeHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your backup codes instead.
AdminAuth.setupSubtitle: Admins must use an authenticator app. This takes about a minute.
AdminAuth.setupStep1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis.
AdminAuth.setupStep2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code.
AdminAuth.setupStep3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
AdminAuth.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
AdminAuth.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
AdminAuth.backupCodesHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe and private. They are shown only now.
AdminAuth.alreadyEnabled: Two-factor sign-in is already on for your account.

errors.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Check the time on your phone and try again.
errors.mfa_locked: Too many wrong codes. Two-factor sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_link: This link is not valid. It may have expired or been used already. Ask for a new one.
errors.too_short: The password is too short (at least 12 characters).
errors.too_long: The password is too long (128 characters at most).
errors.same_as_identifier: The password can't be your username, email or name.

AdminAuth.setPasswordSubtitle: Choose the password for your Clicksp admin account.
AdminAuth.passwordSetDone: Your password is set. Sign in with it now.
AdminAuth.passwordRules: At least 12 characters, not your username. A long phrase works well.
AdminAuth.forgotStaff: Ask a Super Admin (or your Business Admin, for Store Staff accounts) to create a one-time reset link for you in People › Admins and staff.

AdminPeople.usersIntro: Accounts that can sign in to this admin panel.
AdminPeople.noUsers: No accounts you can manage yet.
AdminPeople.addAdminIntro: Create the account, then give the person the one-time link to set their password. They turn on two-factor sign-in at their first sign-in.

fields.name: Name
fields.usernameHint: For signing in: 3–50 lower-case English letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

AdminPeople.createHelp: No password is set here: the person chooses their own with the link.
AdminPeople.roleHelp: Changing the role signs the person out on every device, so the new permissions start with a fresh sign-in.
AdminPeople.passwordHelp: Lost password? Create a one-time reset link (valid 30 minutes). Their current password keeps working until they use it.
AdminPeople.inviteHelp: This person hasn't set a password yet. Create a new one-time link (valid 72 hours); earlier links stop working.
AdminPeople.mfaOnHelp: If they lost their phone and backup codes, remove their authenticator. They scan a new QR code at the next sign-in.
AdminPeople.mfaOffHelp: Not set up yet. It is set up at the next sign-in.
AdminPeople.resetMfaConfirm: I checked this request really comes from this person. Remove their authenticator and sign them out everywhere.
AdminPeople.sessionsHelp: Where this account is signed in now.
AdminPeople.disableHelp: A disabled account can't sign in and is signed out everywhere. Nothing is deleted.
AdminPeople.enableHelp: This account is disabled. Enable it to let the person sign in again.

errors.invalid_username: Username: 3–50 lower-case English letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.invalid_email: That email address is not valid.
errors.email_taken: That email is already used by another account.

messages.created: Account created. Give the person this link to set their password:
messages.roleChanged: Role changed. The person has been signed out.
messages.disabled: Account disabled and signed out everywhere.
messages.inviteIssued: New link created. Earlier links no longer work.
messages.resetIssued: Reset link created. It works once, for 30 minutes.
messages.mfaReset: Authenticator removed and signed out everywhere.

AdminRoles.title: Roles and permissions
AdminRoles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Each admin has one role. Business Admin and Store Staff bundles can be adjusted; the Super Admin bundle is fixed.
AdminRoles.createHelp: For example a “Warehouse staff” role with stock permissions only. It starts with no permissions.

fields.name: Name
fields.keyHint: Lower-case English letters, digits and _ (e.g. warehouse_staff). Can't be changed later.
fields.levelHint: Decides the highest permissions the role can ever hold.
fields.active: Active (members can sign in with this role)

AdminRoles.readonlyMember: You hold this role yourself, so you can't change it.
AdminRoles.readonlyLevel: This role's permissions are fixed or above what you can change.
AdminRoles.permissionsHelp: Changes apply to everyone with this role at their next click. “Only their categories/warehouses” limits a permission to the scopes given to each person.

errors.invalid_description: The description is too long (500 characters at most).
errors.invalid_key: Key: lower-case English letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
errors.taken: A role with that key already exists.
